nodes.label: Card Content Block Icon (SVG)
nodes.description: 16x16 SVG icon representing the card content block. Depicts a card UI layout: outer white rectangle with grey border, a dark header bar at top, two lighter grey text lines below it, a blue/indigo image placeholder area on the right with a white mountain/landscape thumbnail icon and a small circle (simulating an image), and three grey horizontal lines on the left (simulating text rows). Used as the backend icon for the card ContentBlock element in TYPO3.
